markup.[[x]]: 重点形式：这个语法要你注意的词（橙底）
markup.{x}: 变化的部分：只用在 [[ ]] 里，例如 work{s}（橙底里加粗下划线）
markup.((x)): 变回原形的动词（虚线下划线）
markup.~~x~~: 错句里错的部分（删除线）

idea.title: 一句话说清
idea.text: 定语从句就是**挂在名词后面的一小句话**，说清「是哪一个」。像贴小标签：the developer **who fixed the bug**＝「修好 bug 的那个开发」。

uses.en: The developer [[who]] fixed the bug is on holiday.
uses.en_zh: 修好那个 bug 的开发在休假。

uses.en: The app [[which]] crashed yesterday is ours.
uses.en_zh: 昨天崩溃的那个 App 是我们的。

uses.en: Is this the laptop [[that]] you ordered?
uses.en_zh: 这是你订的那台笔记本吗？

build.title: 怎么搭起来
build.rule: 先说名词，紧跟着用 who / which / that 接上小句子。**who / which / that 已经代替了前面那个名词**，小句子里别再说一遍 he、it。

examples.en: The woman [[who]] runs the stand-up is our new PM.
examples.zh: 主持站会的那位女士是我们的新项目经理。

examples.en: I lost the charger [[which]] I borrowed from Sam.
examples.zh: 我把从 Sam 那儿借的充电器弄丢了。

examples.en: The flat [[that]] we saw at the weekend was too small.
examples.zh: 我们周末看的那套公寓太小了。

wrong.bad: The app which I downloaded ~~it~~ yesterday is great.
wrong.good: The app [[which]] I downloaded yesterday is great.

build.tip: 找名词：小标签总是紧跟在它要说明的那个名词后面。

choose.title: 用哪个词

items.en: The colleague [[who]] sits next to me is from Leeds.
items.zh: 坐我旁边的同事是利兹人。

items.en: The bug [[which]] you reported is fixed.
items.zh: 你报的那个 bug 修好了。

items.rule: **that** 人和东西都能用；前面有 best、first、only、all 时更常用 that。
items.en: It's the best talk [[that]] I've ever heard.
items.zh: 这是我听过最好的演讲。

items.en: Is there anything [[that]] I can do?

choose.tip: 拿不准时，说口语用 that 基本不会错。

whose.title: whose 和 where

items.rule: **whose** = 「谁的」，后面紧跟一个名词：whose icons。
items.en: That's the designer [[whose]] icons we use.
items.zh: 那就是我们用的图标的设计师。

items.rule: whose 前面可以是人，也可以是东西。
items.en: I know a guy [[whose]] sister works at Apple.
items.zh: 我认识一个人，他姐姐在苹果工作。

items.rule: **where** = 「在那儿」，前面是地方，后面句子是完整的。
items.en: This is the café [[where]] we had our first meeting.
items.zh: 这就是我们第一次开会的那家咖啡馆。

notes: whose 和 who's 读音一样，意思不同：who's = who is。写的时候别弄混。

omit.title: 什么时候可以省
omit.rule: who / which / that 后面**紧跟着另一个人或东西**（I、you、the team…），这个词可以省掉。后面直接就是动词，就不能省。

examples.rule: 后面是 you → 可以省
examples.en: The bug ([[that]]) you found is fixed now.
examples.zh: 你发现的那个 bug 现在修好了。

examples.rule: 后面是 I → 可以省
examples.en: The book ([[which]]) I'm reading is about design.
examples.zh: 我正在读的那本书是讲设计的。

examples.rule: 后面是 called → 不能省
examples.en: The man [[who]] called you is on the phone again.
examples.zh: 给你打电话的那个人又打来了。

omit.tip: 口诀：**后面有人，可以省；后面是动词，不能省。**

this.meaning: 定语从句：挂在名词后面，说清是哪个人
this.en: I know the man [[who]] wrote this.

that.meaning: 宾语从句：挂在 know 后面，整句是「知道的内容」

this.meaning: 地方 + 后面句子缺东西 → which
this.en: This is the office [[which]] we rented.

that.meaning: 地方 + 后面句子是完整的 → where
that.en: This is the office [[where]] we work.

commonMistakes.bad: The app which I downloaded ~~it~~ is great.
commonMistakes.good: The app [[which]] I downloaded is great.
commonMistakes.why: which 已经代替了 app，别再说 it。

commonMistakes.bad: The phone ~~who~~ I bought is broken.
commonMistakes.good: The phone [[which]] I bought is broken.
commonMistakes.why: 东西用 which 或 that，不用 who。

commonMistakes.bad: The man ~~which~~ helped me was kind.
commonMistakes.good: The man [[who]] helped me was kind.

commonMistakes.bad: The colleague ~~sits~~ next to me is nice.
commonMistakes.good: The colleague [[who]] sits next to me is nice.
commonMistakes.why: 后面直接是动词，who 不能省。
名词后面接小句子用 that，不用 what。

quiz.prompt: The developer ___ fixed the bug is on holiday.
翻译：昨天崩溃的那个 App 是我们的。
quiz.answer: The app that crashed yesterday is ours.
accept: The app which crashed yesterday is ours.
quiz.explain: 东西用 [[that]] 或 [[which]]，挂在 app 后面。

quiz.prompt: 改错：The laptop which I ordered it last week is here.
quiz.answer: The laptop which I ordered last week is here.
accept: The laptop that I ordered last week is here.
The laptop I ordered last week is here.

traps.input: The laptop which I ordered it last week is here.
traps.note: it 和 which 重复了，要删掉 it。

quiz.explain: which 已经代替了 laptop，去掉 it。

quiz.prompt: 用 who 把两句合成一句：The woman runs the stand-up. She is our new PM.
quiz.answer: The woman who runs the stand-up is our new PM.
accept: The woman that runs the stand-up is our new PM.
quiz.explain: 把 she 换成 [[who]]，挂在 woman 后面。

quiz.prompt: The bug ___ you reported is fixed.
It's the best film ___ I've seen this year.
Is there anything ___ I can do?
I know a guy ___ sister works at Apple.
This is the café ___ we had our first meeting.
用 whose 合成一句：That's the designer. We use her icons.
quiz.answer: That's the designer whose icons we use.
accept: That is the designer whose icons we use.
quiz.explain: her icons 变成 [[whose]] icons，放到前面。

quiz.prompt: 哪一句里的 that 可以省掉？
options: The bug that you found is fixed.
The man that called you is here.
The app that crashed is ours.
quiz.answer: The bug that you found is fixed.
quiz.explain: that 后面紧跟 you，可以省。

quiz.prompt: 改错：The colleague sits next to me is from Leeds.
quiz.answer: The colleague who sits next to me is from Leeds.
accept: The colleague that sits next to me is from Leeds.
quiz.explain: 后面直接是动词 sits，[[who]] 不能省。

quiz.prompt: 改错：The phone who I bought last week is broken.
quiz.answer: The phone which I bought last week is broken.
accept: The phone that I bought last week is broken.
The phone I bought last week is broken.

quiz.prompt: 改错：That's the thing what I need.
quiz.answer: That's the thing that I need.
accept: That is the thing that I need.
That's the thing which I need.

quiz.prompt: This is the office ___ we rented last year.
quiz.explain: rented 后面缺东西（租了什么），用 [[which]]。

quiz.prompt: 翻译：我们周末看的那套公寓太小了。
quiz.answer: The flat that we saw at the weekend was too small.
accept: The flat we saw at the weekend was too small.
The flat which we saw at the weekend was too small.
The flat that we saw on the weekend was too small.
The flat we saw on the weekend was too small.
quiz.explain: flat 后面挂 [[that]] we saw…；英式说 at the weekend。

openTask.prompt: 用定语从句写 3 句话，介绍你团队里的人或你用的工具。至少一句用 who，一句用 which 或 that。
rules: 人用 who / that，东西用 which / that
从句里不要再重复 he / she / it
openTask.note: 规则判 who / which / that 用法（计分）；离线模型给更自然的说法（AI 建议，不计分）
